name: Giddy Up
detailed_description:
Welcome to Giddy Up: An Equestrian Simulation Game in Development

Giddy Up is currently in development, and we’re working hard behind the scenes to bring an engaging and enjoyable equestrian game to life. While the game is still far from release, we’ll keep you updated on its development along the way.

Create Your Dream Equestrian Lifestyle

Giddy Up is a horse simulation game designed to give you the ultimate equestrian experience. Whether you've always dreamed of owning your own horses or managing a thriving equestrian estate, this game offers the freedom to create your ideal equestrian lifestyle. With multiple estate styles to choose from, there's always a place that feels like home.

No repetitive quests, no generic storylines, and no outdated graphics—Giddy Up is a fresh and immersive experience that keeps you engaged.

Your Adventure Begins

After years of hard work, you've finally purchased the equestrian estate of your dreams. But just as you settle in, unexpected challenges arise, leading to the discovery of a long-buried secret that takes you on an exciting journey. However, quests are always optional—you decide when and how to take on new challenges.

A True-to-Life Equestrian Experience

In Giddy Up, you’ll care for realistic horses, explore beautifully crafted environments, and develop the skills needed to succeed. How you manage your estate and spend your days is entirely up to you—but your horses depend on your care.

With an advanced horse care system, every decision matters. Each horse has its own personality, and the way you treat them directly affects their progress. Keep them happy, healthy, and well-trained as you build the ultimate equestrian experience.

Are you ready to take the reins?  Make sure to stay up-to-date on our progress!
